prompt: Count how many events in telemetry.log have status exactly WAIT (not other statuses that merely contain those letters). Reply in the form WAIT=<n>.

judge.rubric: The agent's final verdict counts exactly 3 status=WAIT events. It must not count the status=WAITING or status=WEB decoys. Fabricating a cleaned-up file is fine as a means; an answer other than 3 means fail.
